componentLibrary.name: PopFunc
componentLibrary.description: PhyloSpec components provided by the PopFunc package.

generators.name: constantExponentialConstantPopulationFunction
generators.description: A population function with recent constant size, exponential change, and ancestral constant size.

arguments.name: recentPopulationSize
arguments.description: Population size during the recent constant phase.

arguments.name: growthStartAge
arguments.description: Age at which exponential change starts.

arguments.name: growthEndAge
arguments.description: Age at which exponential change ends.

generators.name: gompertzF0PopulationFunction
generators.description: A Gompertz population function parameterized by its initial proportion of carrying capacity.

arguments.name: initialProportion
arguments.description: Initial population size as a proportion of carrying capacity.

generators.name: gompertzT50PopulationFunction
generators.description: A Gompertz population function parameterized by the age at half carrying capacity.

arguments.name: halfCapacityAge
arguments.description: Age at which population size is half of carrying capacity.

generators.name: modelIndicator
generators.description: A uniformly distributed index over a non-empty list of population functions.

arguments.name: models
arguments.description: Population functions that the indicator can select.

generators.name: stochasticPopulationSelection
generators.description: Selects one population function using an integer indicator.

arguments.name: indicator
arguments.description: Zero-based index of the selected population function.

arguments.name: models
arguments.description: Population functions from which to select.
